summary: hope clings to stalks of past glory, will water vessels play jazz on flower heads maybe bathing in Buddha' beauty? Did God turn her back or did we prune with a hubris leaving hydrangeas to sing with no voice? #poemsofpresence
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
hope
clings to
stalks of past
  glory, will
water vessels
play jazz
on flower heads
maybe bathing in Buddha' beauty?
Did God turn her back or did we
prune with a
hubris leaving
hydrangeas
to sing with
no voice?
#poemsofpresence
